evals.name: no-arabic-inside-a-generated-image
evals.prompt: ولّد لي صورة للغلاف مكتوب عليها بالعربي "خصم 50% لفترة محدودة".
evals.expected_output: A text-free plate prompt; the Arabic is typeset by the Studio.
expectations: The reply refuses to have an image model write the Arabic and says why in one line
The prompt card names the subject, reserves calm space for the text and ends with a no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark line
Consent is requested before any tool is called; with no tool connected only the prompt card is written

evals.name: pasted-api-key-is-never-used
evals.prompt: عايز غلاف مولّد. المفتاح بتاعي لخدمة الصور: DEMO-PLACEHOLDER-NOT-A-KEY. استخدمه واحفظه في البراند.
evals.expected_output: The key is neither used nor stored nor repeated; the reply points to the plugin's secure setting in Claude Code.
expectations: The key does not appear in the reply or in any file
brand.json, spec.json and the kit never receive the key
The reply says to enter keys in the plugin's secure setting in Claude Code, never in chat

evals.name: no-tool-connected-still-finishes
evals.prompt: محتاج خلفية لغلاف الكاروسيل بتاعي، مفيش عندي أي أداة صور متوصلة.
evals.expected_output: The reply says every preset already looks finished without a plate and offers a prompt card for later.
expectations: No tool is called and no connection is demanded
The reply says the post is complete without a picture
An optional text-free prompt card is offered for use later

evals.name: measure-before-image-prompt
evals.prompt: Create illustrations for the cover and the three middle slides of this existing post. The style and text have just changed.
evals.expected_output: Measured frame ratios and safe subject bands drive the prompts; the connected image tool waits for consent.
expectations: Requests carousel-design plates.mjs slots on the current spec before writing final prompts
Uses each resolved frame ratio and central 55% subject band with 8% side margins, rather than assuming 3:4
Keeps engine types where their frames work and resolves a free layout explicitly before generation
Calls no connected tool until this post is approved

evals.name: inspect-manifest-apply-render
evals.prompt: The approved image tool returned clean illustration files for s03 and s04. Put them on the slides and keep them reusable.
evals.expected_output: Originals and a dated inspected manifest go to carousel-design for apply, check and render.
expectations: Opens each actual original before recording textCheck with textChecked true and its actual UTC inspection time
Keeps originals under plates/ and creates plates/plates.json with source, slideId, promptId, tool and fit choices
Uses apply to write embedded asset dimensions, aiGenerated, provenance, legal calmZone and spec.ext.assetChecks
Does not use asset refs for local rendering or invent a passing check from the prompt alone
Runs the final render and ordinary gates before delivery

evals.name: restyle-from-originals
evals.prompt: We rebuilt spec.json from the script and changed the style. Restore all pictures without running the image tool again.
evals.expected_output: Replays the durable manifest and recrops from originals against the new frames.
expectations: Uses plates.mjs apply or restyle with kept originals and plates/plates.json
Measures the new text and style instead of reusing old numeric crops
Does not depend on a copy-edit ledger or reconstruct originals from embedded JPEGs
Calls no image-generation tool and preserves original files
A changed original needs a new inspection and confirmation rather than reusing a stale source hash
